metropolis.page.title: Metropolis - Dovecot Studio
metropolis.intro.line_1: The opening of London's steam-hauled Metropolitan Railway in 1863
metropolis.intro.line_2: marked the beginning of rapid transit.
metropolis.features.decoration.title: Station decoration
metropolis.features.decoration.descripti: Metropolis adds benches, security scanners, platform screen doors, stopping markers, and a variety of building blocks to enrich every detail of your station.
metropolis.features.fares.title: Fare system
metropolis.features.fares.description: Building on MTR's fare system, Metropolis redesigns the ticket interface and IC card system. Interactive gates and ticket machines make each journey feel more complete.
metropolis.features.fares.note: Note: Metropolis and MTR tickets are not interchangeable.
metropolis.features.tracks.title: More tracks
metropolis.features.tracks.description: Alongside new blocks, Metropolis includes more than ten practical track models for a range of track-building needs.
metropolis.features.tracks.platform: Platform track models also make it easy to build curved platforms.
metropolis.features.integration.title: Seamless integration
